{"id": "0fc27462-c491-4c60-a957-9e36485ecd47", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "We're about to merge PR #14 in acme/payments-infra. It's the first infrastructure PR in that repo, there's no pipeline review set up, and finance wants to know what this stack is going to add to the AWS bill every month before we approve it. Can you work that out from the PR?

The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.

--- PR #14 (feature/ledger -> main) ---
Base branch main: no cloudformation/ directory.
Files added: cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml, .github/workflows/deploy.yml

--- .github/workflows/deploy.yml (excerpt) ---
env:
  AWS_REGION: eu-west-1
  STACK_NAME: payments-ledger
run: aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger --template-file cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml --region eu-west-1

--- cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml (Resources; Parameters hold only VPC and subnet IDs) ---
  LedgerDbSubnetGroup: {Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup, Properties: {SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB]}}
  LedgerDb:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties: {Engine: postgres, DBInstanceClass: db.r6g.large, MultiAZ: true, AllocatedStorage: "200", StorageType: gp3, DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref LedgerDbSubnetGroup}
  ReconcilerNatEip: {Type: AWS::EC2::EIP, Properties: {Domain: vpc}}
  ReconcilerNatGateway: {Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway, Properties: {AllocationId: !GetAtt ReconcilerNatEip.AllocationId, SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA}}
  AlbSecurityGroup: {Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup}
  ApiLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties: {Type: application, Scheme: internet-facing, Subnets: [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB], SecurityGroups: [!Ref AlbSecurityGroup]}
  ArchiveBucket: {Type: AWS::S3::Bucket, Properties: {VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}}}
  ReconcilerRole: {Type: AWS::IAM::Role}
  ReconcilerFunction: {Type: AWS::Lambda::Function, Properties: {Runtime: python3.12, Architectures: [arm64], MemorySize: 512, Role: !GetAtt ReconcilerRole.Arn}}

--- AWS (read-only), eu-west-1 ---
cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name payments-ledger
  -> ValidationError: Stack with id payments-ledger does not exist

--- pricing get-products (endpoint us-east-1, filter regionCode=eu-west-1), OnDemand terms only ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-09  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.large       databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs   "unused capacity reservation hour"
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage     volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-01  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Hours             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per Hrs
AmazonEC2  SKU FX-NAT-02  usagetype EU-NatGateway-Bytes             productFamily=NAT Gateway   0.050 USD per GB
AmazonVPC  SKU FX-IP-01   usagetype EU-PublicIPv4:InUseAddress                                  0.005 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-01  usagetype EU-LoadBalancerUsage            productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.025 USD per Hrs
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-03  usagetype EU-TS-LoadBalancerUsage         productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.006 USD per Hrs   "trust store unit-hour"
AWSELB     SKU FX-ALB-02  usagetype EU-LCUUsage                     productFamily=Load Balancer-Application   0.008 USD per LCU-Hrs", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "e3a5b90a-c0b8-4e7a-be7f-c0d79b6e5991", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "Estimate monthly AWS costs for PR #14 infrastructure"}]}

{"id": "f014e71f-dedf-46a6-992c-5668688015d8", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "This is a cost estimation task based on the PR's CloudFormation template and the given synthetic pricing data — straightforward arithmetic I can compute directly without any AWS calls or further investigation, since all the needed data is already in the prompt.

Working through the resources: the DB subnet group is free, and the RDS instance (db.r6g.large, Multi-AZ, 200GB gp3) comes to about $415/mo combining the $365 Multi-AZ instance hours and $50 storage cost. For the NAT setup, the gateway hours add $36.50/mo, but data processing costs are usage-dependent and can't be pinned down, and I'm weighing whether the attached EIP incurs the new public IPv4 hourly charge or is free since it's in active use.

For the ALB, I'm tallying the $18.25/mo base usage cost, flagging the trust store charge as inapplicable since no mTLS is configured, and noting that LCU usage is traffic-dependent so I need to decide on a reasonable minimum estimate.

The S3 bucket and Lambda function both lack pricing data in the fixture, so I'll flag those as missing SKU data rather than guess. Now I'm organizing the final answer into predictable fixed costs versus usage-dependent costs, starting with the RDS instance pricing.

The ALB Trust Store charge doesn't apply since mutual TLS isn't configured here, so that's $0/N/A, and the RDS unused capacity reservation line is also irrelevant for this standard provisioned instance. I'm noting that some SKUs like S3 are missing from the pricing data I pulled, so those costs can't be calculated yet.

Both the S3 bucket (storage/requests) and Lambda function (invocation/duration) costs can't be priced since their SKUs weren't returned and I lack volume estimates anyway. So my answer comes out to a fixed floor around $473/month, plus variable NAT and ALB costs that scale with traffic, plus unquantifiable S3 and Lambda costs -- and I should spell out my assumptions like 730 hrs/month and a single NAT gateway.

I also confirm the stack doesn't exist yet in eu-west-1, so this is entirely new spend rather than something already baked into the current bill. This is a straightforward computation with all the data already given, so I'll just work it out directly and present it clearly, maybe as a table, without needing to treat it as a full visual artifact since that wasn't requested.

I'll check the EIP charge logic — since it's attached to a NAT gateway and AWS now bills in-use public IPv4 addresses separately from the NAT Gateway hourly fee, that charge should be included. I also note the RDS line item has a zero rate, so it can be safely ignored.

Summing everything gives a fixed monthly floor of $473.40, which I'll present clearly and note that actual usage-based components will push this higher. I have everything needed to answer directly without further tool calls.

"}]}

{"id": "f20168dc-4209-490b-8c94-30debb133f22", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Here's the monthly cost breakdown for the `payments-ledger` stack, based on the resources in `cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml` and the pricing lookups provided. I'm using a standard 730 hrs/month assumption, and since the stack doesn't exist yet (confirmed by the `ValidationError` on `describe-stacks`), this entire estimate is net-new spend.

**Fixed, predictable costs**

| Resource | Rate | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| RDS `db.r6g.large`, Multi-AZ (instance hours) | $0.500/hr × 730 | $365.00 |
| RDS storage, 200 GB gp3 | $0.250/GB-mo × 200 | $50.00 |
| NAT Gateway (hourly) | $0.050/hr × 730 | $36.50 |
| Elastic IP (in-use address, attached to NAT GW) | $0.005/hr × 730 | $3.65 |
| ALB (hourly) | $0.025/hr × 730 | $18.25 |
| **Subtotal (floor)** | | **$473.40/month** |

**Usage-dependent — can't be fixed from the PR alone**

- **NAT Gateway data processing** — $0.050/GB on everything the reconciler pushes through the NAT (outbound to internet/AWS services). Scales with reconciler traffic volume, which isn't knowable from the template.
- **ALB LCU-hours** — $0.008/LCU-Hr, driven by connections, bandwidth, and rule evaluations once the API is live. No traffic data to size this yet.
- **ALB Trust Store unit-hours** ($0.006/hr) — only billed if mutual TLS trust store is configured on the listener. Nothing in the template sets that up, so I'd expect $0 here, but flagging it since the SKU showed up in the lookup.
- **RDS "unused capacity reservation"** SKU returned at $0.000/hr — not applicable to a standard provisioned Multi-AZ instance like this one; safe to ignore.

**Not priced — missing from the pricing data pulled**

- **`ArchiveBucket` (S3, versioning enabled)** — no S3 SKU came back in the lookup, so storage/request/versioning-growth costs aren't captured at all. Worth a follow-up pricing pull before finance signs off.
- **`ReconcilerFunction` (Lambda, arm64, 512MB)** — no Lambda SKU in the lookup either, and even with one, it'd need an invocation-volume estimate the PR doesn't specify.

**Bottom line for finance:** this stack adds a **floor of ~$473/month** in fixed infrastructure costs, before any NAT data processing, ALB traffic, S3, or Lambda usage is factored in — those will push the real number higher once the reconciler and API are actually running.

Want me to pull S3 and Lambda pricing for eu-west-1 so you have a more complete number before this merges?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
